title: Marketing Post Dispatcher (English pillar)
description: Sibling of marketing-post, pointed at factory/marketing-en/ instead of factory/marketing/. Every hour, checks that pillar's posting timetable and fires whatever content type(s) are due against @komori_en, respecting per-content-type autonomy and the shared cross-pillar browser lock with marketing-post so the two never fight over the same Chrome profile.
